title: Brown Brothers Harriman, Versailles reparations and Union Bank financing of Hitler

tellings.quote: in 1924 George Herbert Walker leaves Brown Brothers Herman sets up the the Union Bank of New York completely capitalized by the guy who are part of Brown Brothers Herman

plain: The claim is that a group of American bankers and lawyers tied to the peace deal after the First World War went on to fund Hitler's rise through a New York bank. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells it, passing on what he was told, and links names including the diplomat Robert Lansing, the brothers John Foster Dulles and Allen Dulles, and the German industrialist Fritz Thyssen to the Treaty of Versailles, the agreement that ended that war and set German war payments. He says that "in 1924 George Herbert Walker leaves Brown Brothers" Harriman, a Wall Street bank, and sets up the Union Bank of New York, paid for entirely by partners of that same firm, which he says then helped finance the Nazis before 1939.
